3144.title: Completed turns fold pre-terminal assistant prose
3144.rootCauseOneLine: Completed-turn grouping classifies ordinary assistant-text messages as summary-groupable unless they are adjacent to another assistant-text message, so tool-separated prose is moved into a collapsed turn row.
3144.proposedFix: After deciding the completed-turn presentation policy, keep non-legacy top-level assistant text as ungrouped rows while grouping surrounding work, then update row-count/cache benchmarks and app/CLI snapshots.
3144.caveats: The deterministic shared projection path was reproduced twice without starting a provider or app instance; provider-specific transcript parity was not tested.
